leads.title: Popular open source AI developer tool Ollama raises $65M, grows to nearly 9M users
sentences: The popular open source AI tool Ollama has raised a $65 million Series B, led by Theory Ventures, founder and CEO Jeff Morgan tells TechCrunch. .
This round follows a previous $15 million Series A led by Benchmark’s Peter Fenton.
All told, the company has now raised $88 million. .

leads.title: Kitematic founders nab $65 million USD to help devs run AI models with Ollama
sentences: Canadian-founded, Palo Alto-based software startup Ollama has secured $65 million USD ($91 million CAD) in Series B funding to enable AI’s “personal computer moment.”.
Ollama aims to build on that growth with its Series B; the company announced the round earlier this month.

leads.title: The 20 hottest open source startups of 2024
sentences: In top spot on the 2024 ROSS Index is Ollama , a Y Combinator alum that’s built an open source tool for running LLMs such as Meta’s Llama and DeepSeek locally (i.e., desktop).

leads.title: Is Canada building enough robots?
sentences: Canadian-founded Ollama raises $65 million USD to help devs run open-source AI models.

leads.title: Open source Notion alternative AppFlowy gets big-name backers and lands on the cloud
sentences: AppFlowy , as the company is called, has raised $6.4 million in funding from a slew of renowned founders, including Matt Mullenweg (Automattic); Steve Chen (YouTube); Tom Preston-Werner (GitHub); Bob Young (Red Hat) and Amr Awadallah (Cloudera).
